notes.title: KONOSUBA! OUT NOW!

notes.title: Meet Kazuma the game obsessed, shut-in adventurer!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44244384/0f7785dabf6ddd1a19cff8dd766ce2f75bd192c4.gif[/img]

ONE DAY TO GO!!❤️‍🔥 Here's our final character introduction!!

🎮 Kazuma was a video game-loving shut-in who was reincarnated into this new world as an adventurer! He has found himself the leader of a party full of misfits.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44244384/cea6eacf3e726271d9aa89d688fc8775975baa66.jpg[/img]
Kazuma displays a persona of harshness, often guiding the party in ways he believes to be right and pushing the fellow members to follow his given orders. 🌟👨‍✈️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44244384/8ff1d012e6e5fcb62f5d452c8f87aaa8081b58f7.jpg[/img]
🌟 Kazuma is often viewed to be cynical, continuously looking for personal gain. Although he displays no real trust in his fellow party and will be the first to question them, he does prove to care for them. 🤔💰

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44244384/94ced40a2aa6afc331ea94bc85ab65d124a63e7c.jpg[/img]

👕 Kazuma appears with slightly spiked chestnut-brown hair and is shown wearing his usual green tracksuit or his adventurer outfit: a green mantle lined with gold trims, a white shirt, pants, and leather boots. 🌟👖
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44244384/1f828308f9c47474624e2be1e316a0c0be98b586.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Meet Darkness the masochistic crusader!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44244384/84343363490a170bdfc2075f4d31fb3dc95e32d8.gif[/img]

🛡️ Darkness  is a crusader that presents herself as the picture of nobility, committed to shielding others from harm. Her tone is measured, stern and strict, which can come off as if she is extremely mature.⚔️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44244384/8e4ab61efda51f62874a4a744335ea10b06c2ce1.jpg[/img]
However, beneath that noble façade she conceals a completely perverted masochistic side🤫 
Though her desire is to protect others, what truly fuels her are fulfilling the urges of her masochistic and sometimes submissive, desires. Darkness is progressively becoming more open about her true intentions and revealing her wants and needs. ✨

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44244384/29fa6257339d889f4400a02819c2f0352fdbe8e7.jpg[/img]
⚔️ Despite her strength and stamina, Darkness's incompetence wielding swords limits her abilities in battle, often causing her to miss targets in her direct line of vision. Whilst she may comes across as strong-minded, these missed attacks leave her feeling uncomfortable and humiliated.

However, the worst humiliation for her is being made fun of by using her real name – Lalatina. 😔

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44244384/360e8c91ac8f994606b43b85119134558aae3123.jpg[/img]

Darkness is tall compared to the rest of the gang, and appears with long, straight blond hair, usually tied in a ponytail with her fringe held by red clips. Her usual attire consists of a yellow, black and white dress with silver armour pieces, and a wing motif on her shoulder. 🌟👗

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44244384/c1a3b1ce9e1def1b98c7a30db75390e729604bdf.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Meet Megumin an Arch Wizard of the Crimson Demons!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44244384/e2b883821569017a13bfde049ad2b33f1d9e9010.gif[/img]

🔮An exceptional spellcaster even among the magically proficient Crimson Demons, Megumin is a wielder of the fabled Explosion Magic, a spell unrivalled in raw power, but with a terrible drawback - one shot and she is done!💥💥
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44244384/c76752a6a94efe38bace952b93ffddac99b5b7bd.jpg[/img]
Despite being a powerful Arch Wizard, Megumin's true nature reveals her to be rather childish and immature. With this, she is extremely sensitive to comments about her age and body. Her response to this is to be aggressive and petty. 💥
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44244384/c4f045aff925793c4878c8c18ca4dd3f80ad290e.jpg[/img]
🔥Megumin is also just as eccentric as the other girls in the gang. From her obsession with explosive magic to boasting about her powers, she can be as arrogant as she is cute at times. 💬 However, in more desperate and dangerous situations, she can change her act and become more hostile or provide unexpected intellect. 🌪️🔥
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44244384/1411f1ec1605355de972e9f692389994bbbd17d7.jpg[/img]
Megumin appears with shoulder length dark hair and crimson-coloured eyes. Her normal attire is a classic cloak with a red robe, boots, and a wizard’s hat, all with gold trimmings. She also carries a brown staff, that has a floating gem. 💫🌟
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44244384/38380ad7d76e3cc089ee52b6f8af8a50b271f1f1.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44244384/f8f1ad2adf4a2ebaa2696a244945824866b884dc.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Meet Aqua the Useless Goddess!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44244384/f9395c4fde0bdd5ff8cab7115ffed5f1fa415462.gif[/img]

💧 A water goddess who was reluctantly dragged into the other world by Kazuma. In order for her to return to where she came from she needs to help defeat the Devil King, but it seems like she's forgotten this purpose in favour of enjoying an easy going life.

✨High-spirited, lively, and carefree, she's everyone’s favourite goddess, or so she wants us to believe! 🌊
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44244384/5d156e3282ec958f51eb0342d5a89d981ecffa55.jpg[/img]
💫 Her actions are normally driven without thought of consequence so her behaviour can sometimes come across as inappropriate as she often doesn't think before she speaks or acts. 🤷‍♀️💬

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44244384/2860de1df8c2ba4c08c60f5876b44b220249ae1a.jpg[/img]
🌟 Aqua is extremely easy to taunt and manipulate - praise her, lure her with goodies, and she will do as you say. As a goddess, she thrives on praise and worship. If she performs well, it is expected that she shall receive praise. If this is not the case, she becomes persistent. Not doing this will often turn into a disaster. 🙏💥

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44244384/c16088dbed700827ae1784f89e9e29f37acaaee5.jpg[/img]
💧 Aqua has long light blue hair that is partially tied with a spherical clip representing a water molecule. She's mostly seen wearing a sleeveless dark-blue vest with white linings, detached sleeves, a green bow with a blue gem, and a short dark blue miniskirt. 🌊💙✨

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44244384/98bd1cd99013995d231c8246b19e147ec5724748.jpg[/img]

notes.title: COMING FEBRUARY 8TH 2024!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44244384/9b268e8efe1e4c2ec4c4fac575f0dd2b58f8487f.jpg[/img]

Konosuba - God’s blessing on this wonderful world! Love for these Clothes of Desire! Will be coming on Thursday 8th February 2024! 

[previewyoutube=QGS46TtxRfo;full][/previewyoutube]

Featuring the hit characters from the series! Its nearly time for a new Konosuba story in Visual Novel Form.

Follow Kazuma and the girls as they discover a mysterious ‘black slab' which unleashes a curse, causing  their personalities to flip. Assign the party to part time jobs and send them out on quests in order to find specific ingredients needed to make outfits on the slab, in order to break the curses!

Unravel the story by making decisions, putting the party to work, managing recourses and building up affections! 

Don't miss out the opportunity to be one of the first to experience the ONLY Konosuba localised visual Novel!
